title: Night 1
intro: Station Kestrel-4. Keep the generator running, keep the heater on, and log the weather every two hours.

station.mugText: A chipped cream mug by the sink, scrubbed clean. HOLLIS is scratched into the glaze.

hints.text: WASD to walk, mouse to look. Click the game first if the mouse isn't looking around.
hints.touch: Drag on the left side of the screen to walk and on the right side to look around.

hints.text: Keep POWER, FUEL and TEMP up. The line at the top right says what to do next.
Walk up to something and its name appears. Press E or click to use it.
hints.touch: Walk up to something and its name appears. Tap USE to use it.

hints.text: A weather reading is due. Go to the met console in the main room and use it.
The generator has stalled. Go to the generator room and use the engine to restart it.
The breaker tripped. The panel is beside the generator room doorway. Use it to reset.
The tank is dry. Pick up a full jerry can (generator room, east wall), carry it to the generator and use the engine to pour.
